set.body: Create a fresh unopened image-backed court whose exact recovery cases satisfy the PRD requirement that truth be identifiable at the declared sampling resolution. Before any Flashalign execution, freeze generator, inputs, transforms, thresholds, independent stationarity or oracle checks, runner and failure adjudication. Use an affine within-modality intensity relationship for the exact-recovery core; keep nonlinear contrast as a separate approximation distribution. Exercise the real automatic public path for rigid and affine cases and retain complete failed rows. No candidate-aware tuning after the seal.
set.title: FA-L30: Freeze an interpolation-identifiable automatic linear confirmation court
